purpose: Outcome-free candidate checkpoint inventory and provisional 400-checkpoint breadth selection for a 1,000-cell checkpoint x generation-policy evaluation matrix.

priority: include a representative from each session lacking an eligible from-base row
include one best available RL/distill row per session
maximize continuation-session coverage using code readiness
fill residual quota by family, weight-operation, LoRA and dataset-source novelty plus code readiness

limitations: candidate_weight_bool is a card/trajectory-derived proxy, not proof of unique tensors.
No model tensor hashes are present in the corpus or HF metadata pin; hash and loadability preflight is mandatory before allocating cells.
Decoding/evaluation cards can select an unarchived intermediate or another existing checkpoint; aliases are only bound when explicit evidence permits.
Normalized parent edges contain no cross-session learned-weight edges, but absence may reflect incomplete declarations; split by whole session.

The pinned HF dataset provides generation_config.json and config.json for all 582 labeled checkpoints (including all 400 selected), but checkpoints_meta does not provide tensor-shard hashes or full tokenizer artifacts; metadata availability does not prove weight identity or a complete serving bundle. Local cache sparsity is not remote HF absence.
The three quarantined scored rows are excluded by the authoritative eligible_for_training flag.

candidate_weight_proxy.definition: Training outputs and parameter-merge outputs after excluding explicit decoding/evaluation/selection bundles; not tensor-hash deduplicated.
